courses.title: Calculus Mastery
courses.shortDesc: Build true fluency in limits, derivatives, and integrals for exam success.
courses.fullDesc: This course takes students from foundational limits through advanced integration techniques, with weekly problem sets modeled on real exam papers. Ideal for students preparing for official baccalaureate or SAT-level math.

courses.title: Physics: Mechanics & Motion
courses.shortDesc: Hands-on experiments in force, motion, and energy conservation.
courses.fullDesc: A lab-driven course covering kinematics, Newton's laws, and energy conservation, with in-person experiments that turn abstract formulas into physical intuition.

courses.title: Organic Chemistry Foundations
courses.shortDesc: Master reaction mechanisms and functional groups from the ground up.
courses.fullDesc: Covers nomenclature, functional groups, and core reaction mechanisms, with visual mechanism-mapping techniques that make organic chemistry far less intimidating.

courses.title: Full-Track Algebra to Calculus
courses.shortDesc: A complete academic-year math track, from algebra fundamentals to calculus.
courses.fullDesc: Our most comprehensive math track — ideal for students who want structured, full-year progress with one consistent instructor from algebra basics through calculus readiness.

courses.title: Literary Analysis & Essay Craft
courses.shortDesc: Sharpen close-reading skills and structured argumentative writing.
courses.fullDesc: Students read closely, argue persuasively, and write essays that hold together — this course pairs classic and contemporary texts with rigorous writing practice.

courses.title: Cell Biology & Genetics
courses.shortDesc: Understand cell structure, function, and the fundamentals of genetics.
courses.fullDesc: From cell membranes to Mendelian genetics, this course builds a strong conceptual foundation using diagrams, analogy, and real case studies.

faqs.question: How do I book a session with an instructor?
faqs.answer: Visit the Instructors or Courses page, choose your instructor or course, and submit the registration form. We'll confirm your session by email or WhatsApp within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Do you offer both online and in-person sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes — each instructor lists their teaching mode (Online or Présentiel) on their profile and on each course page, and many offer both.

faqs.question: What age groups do you teach?
faqs.answer: We work primarily with middle school through university-prep students, with some instructors also offering adult learning support.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a session?
faqs.answer: Yes, contact us at least 24 hours in advance via WhatsApp or email and we'll help you reschedule.

faqs.question: How is pricing determined?
faqs.answer: Each course lists an hourly rate set by the instructor based on subject and level. Full-track programs offer better per-session value.
